prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving interface–outbound-load release at shipping interface; pallets remain inside. Objective: accurate processing/timely dispatch without bypassing safety/inventory controls. No explicit modes.

Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass) maintains authoritative inventory, pallet status/location/eligibility and inbound expectations; authorizes work; produces Slot Reservation Receipt; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment. Movement requires authorization/record reconciliation. Reservations identify position/validation conditions; require position/access availability confirmation. May retain measured dimensions.

Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook) controls access; records vehicle/carrier/trailer/arrival; directs cleared trailers staging-to-door. Drivers obey instructions. Check windows; review unscheduled arrivals before entry. Assignment requires available door/lane/crew; prevent obstruction, monitor clearance, safely hold pending reassignment. Yard personnel notify receiving staff of departure readiness.

Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay) compares paperwork/expectations, confirms presentation, records outcomes/discrepancies/shipment details; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note. Verify identity/seals before unloading; reconcile physical/documented counts; separate damage; pause for unsafe conditions/document/equipment issues. Warehouse Operations Supervisor resolves escalations/priorities/recovery/unresolved allocation. Receiving closes/allocation starts after count/inspection/door-release recording. Acceptance requires valid instruction/safe handling; inspect before storage; inspect/identify before conveyor entry.

Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry) measures height/width/length before suitability finalization; compares configured limits/declared profile; produces Oversize Load Advisory identifying exceeded storage/handling limits, never authorizing noncompliant placement. Inbound Pallet Buffer holds accepted pallets. Allocation considers dimensions/mass/compatibility/retrieval; favors short paths for fast-moving stock; restricted pallets require approved positions. Preserve pallet/equipment clearances; exclude conflicting capacity/status/restrictions.

North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane serve assigned aisles under travel/access limits; zone separation prevents conflicts. Control cross-aisle movement; commands require valid target/aisle conditions. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor use eastern/western approaches; Conveyor Line Controller sequences sections. Autonomous Forklift Fleet requires approved areas/authorized tasks. Outbound Dispatch Sorter sequences pallets; Outbound Checkweigh Scale verifies weight; Shipping Documentation Desk prepares records. Safety Zone Controller restricts protected-area movement; Fire Alarm Panel supplies alarms; Maintenance Release Terminal records availability.

New part:
S079: It uses conveyor status and transfer-point signals to determine when a pallet can advance.
S080: The Conveyor Line Controller maintains a separate sequence for each active conveyor path.
S081: Conveyor Line Controller is also known as Brasshaven in local operating terminology.
S082: At each transfer point, interlocks prevent movement into a section that is occupied or unavailable.
S083: Presence sensors confirm that a pallet has reached the expected position before a transfer is initiated.
S084: A blocked transfer point holds the affected pallet upstream while other clear paths may continue operating.
S085: Accumulation zones provide controlled spacing between pallets when downstream movement pauses.
S086: Release from an accumulation zone occurs only when the next conveyor section reports ready.
S087: At a merge, the controller grants passage to one approaching pallet at a time.
S088: The Conveyor Line Controller produces the Transfer Induction Ticket for each accepted induction.
S089: Each output record carries the identifiers and routing details needed to associate the induction with its pallet.
S090: The controller checks that required induction fields are present before releasing the pallet from the transfer point.
S091: Duplicate induction requests are held for resolution rather than treated as new pallet movements.
S092: The North Aisle Stacker Crane sends the Aisle Occupancy Snapshot.
S093: The reported aisle condition reflects the crane's current view of occupied and available storage positions.
S094: Changes in reported conditions support safer decisions about whether an induction can proceed.
S095: The North Aisle Stacker Crane updates its reported condition as its operating state changes.
S096: If reporting becomes stale, the affected induction path remains held until current status is available.
S097: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor can review persistent holds through established operational procedures.
S098: After a fault is cleared, the controller verifies transfer-point readiness before resuming the held sequence.
S099: Normal sequencing resumes without changing the order of pallets already committed to a transfer path.
S100: Normal sequencing resumes without changing the order of pallets already committed to a transfer path.
S101: Outbound preparation starts when the Warehouse Management System establishes the intended shipment window and loading priorities.
S102: Wave planning accounts for pallet identity, destination, due time, and the available staging positions.
S103: The Warehouse Management System checks that planned pallet moves remain consistent with outbound capacity and current inventory records.
S104: Morrowglass is an operational alias for the Warehouse Management System.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
